interpretation: Baseline and final outcomes match for every controlled combination. Optimized gfx90a rejects the ffmt print/format probe in both snapshots; this is a pre-existing compiler/transport interaction. Optimized gfx942 and unoptimized gfx90a/gfx942 compile successfully. The direct printf control passes throughout, so no general claim that HIP printf is unsupported is warranted.
limitations: Compilation only. No device execution or hardware measurement. These probes do not qualify every formatter case.
